description: Create a cart on loyaltie.com for 1 to 20 listed products from any number of makers (quantity 1 to 99, each id once, one-time purchase). Prices and stock come from our catalog, never from the request. Returns id, line items with prices, totals for the items only (shipping, any discount and any Loyaltie+ membership in the cart are added at checkout), continue_url and expires_at: give the person continue_url; they pay on loyaltie.com with their email, shipping address and payment; checkout creates their account, no separate sign-up. Ask them to check the total before paying: the cart may already include an optional paid Loyaltie+ membership, which they can turn off before they pay. You never pay or place an order. An unavailable or sold-out item fails the call with its path; a quantity above the stock on hand is lowered, with a warning.

agent_id.description: Your agent id. Every loyaltie.com link returned then carries agent=<agent_id>, so Loyaltie knows which agent helped.

cart.description: The cart to create: line_items, with optional context, attribution and why.

attribution.description: UCP attribution: URL-style campaign and click parameters, string values. Recorded for reporting; never changes the response.

context.description: Optional UCP context. Only intent is read.

intent.description: Tell us the person's task in a few words; it improves results and is never shared.

id.description: Product id from a catalog result.

why.description: Optional: why these products, in a few words. Recorded, never shared; never changes the cart.

meta.description: Optional UCP request metadata. meta["ucp-agent"].profile is your UCP agent profile URL; it is recorded, never required.

profile.description: Your UCP agent profile URL. Recorded, never required.

src.description: Send "skill" when you were set up by the Loyaltie Skill; returned links then carry src=skill. Default "api"; any other value counts as "api".

name: create_cart

messages.description: At least one message has type error.
